library.description: RPC host with transport and feature plugins.

blocks.text: `contract` 定义协议、接口、可移植值和错误契约；`host` 负责 RPC 调用、会话、握手、provider、转发与取消。传输 plugin 负责原生连接、代际、编解码、分帧与 transfer；信息流 plugin 和依附于 plugin 的 feature 各自实现可选能力。
一个 host 可以安装多个传输，调用按 `host.<ns>` 隔离。不建议一个 host 混用多种传输；通常每个 host 选择一种。
English · 使用指南
下面建立两个同一事件循环内的真实 host。父端的 timeout feature 安装在 coroutine plugin 上；子端接收本代专属 connect 句柄。输出 `42`，finally 关闭原生资源。
协程不提供 Worker 隔离。独立进程、原生线程和浏览器场景分别选择 process、thread 和 browser 的传输 plugin。

blocks.text: 上述无目标调用只在所属命名空间内选择目标：零个返回空 `fulfilled/rejected`，一个返回标量，多个返回按实例身份索引的 `fulfilled/rejected`。流集合中的迭代器独立取消。根级 `host.request` 等调用入口已删除。
`host.<ns>.send('b', 'c.render', value)` 先到直连 b，再由 b 查询当前目录并转发到 c。持有的 `host.<ns>.peers.c.render` 不会自动改指重连后的新代。转发可跨命名空间，且不能延长上游截止时间。
信息流 plugin 安装进 host 的 `plugins`；feature 安装进所依附 plugin 的 `features`。

汇总入口与默认子路径导入均可 tree-shake。其他信息流 plugin 为 `auth`、`chunk`、`batch`、`idempotency`、`schema`、`typegen`。推荐安装 `limits`；省略它就不启用这些配额。安装 `idempotency` 后，才有 `host.<ns>.outcome(key)`。`auth` 独立拥有请求 ID 重放账本；`maxReplayEntriesPerPeer` 限制每个已接纳对端保留的身份数量，`onRejected` 接收重放容量拒绝原因。
pool 是传输的 `pool({ size })` feature，同一池只包含同载体成员，只公开一个逻辑对端。成员打开、调度和关闭属于 pool；`host.<ns>.members` 由传输提供原生控制。
`FeatureScope` 唯一解析覆盖顺序：单次调用 `options.timeout/retry`、所在传输 plugin 的 feature、链路策略 plugin。单次值只接受完整 feature 实例或 `false`，不接受数字或配置对象。`false` 禁用该策略，不能取消已经继承的链路截止时间。只有发起方重试；转发跳不重新开始预算。
所有调用种类支持 `signal`，单向调用物理发送之后也能向下游传播取消。provider 读取自己的 `context.signal`。取消不等于杀进程，也不回滚业务副作用。
按 `source/code` 识别错误，保留原生类型、`stack`、`cause` 和 `AggregateError.errors`。超时或断开不证明业务未执行；非幂等操作须先对账再考虑重试。

自定义 plugin 作者从 `@migaia/rpc-host/sdk` 开始。观察入口是 `/plugins/probe`；旧 `/plugin`、`/probe`、endpoint、per-session Peer 和 v1/JSON-RPC profile 已删除。rpc 家族可以直接依赖 `@migaia/rpc-contract`；只需错误码时导入 `/error-code`，不会带入协议与编解码执行代码。
README · English
contract 只定义协议、接口、可移植值和错误契约。host 负责 RPC 的会话、握手、调用、provider、转发、取消与截止时间传递。传输 plugin 负责原生连接、代际和编解码；信息流 plugin 与依附于 plugin 的 feature 各自实现可选能力。
一个 host 支持多个传输命名空间，但通常选择一种传输，不建议混用。所有调用写成 `host.<ns>.*`；`provide` 与整个 host 的 `close` 留在根上。完整可运行的双向协程示例见 README。

blocks.text: `provide` 接受嵌套函数对象。返回值成为业务结果，异常保留原错误链；重复方法名拒绝。运行中新增的方法通过原会话目录更新发布。
调用方通过 `options.signal` 取消，处理方读取自己的 `context.signal`。示例 `wait` 等待取消；实际任务应在自己的 finally 中释放资源。取消不回滚已执行副作用，也不自动终止进程。单向调用发送完成后，其 signal 仍可向下游传递取消。
声明可描述一个能力，或按直连名称映射多个能力。命名空间决定使用哪个传输，名称和实例 id 决定该传输内的目标。
无目标 `request/notify/group` 在该命名空间内广播：零目标得到空 `fulfilled/rejected`，单目标返回标量，多目标各自保留成功或失败。多目标 `stream` 返回按实例身份索引的迭代器集合，每个迭代器独立背压和取消。
stream 在第一次 `next()` 才启动。调用 `return()` 结束消费并等待对应清理；`throw(reason)` 保留调用方抛出的原因。连接失效后，已持有能力仍绑定原连接，不能转向同名新实例。
下例只创建冷定义；把 `policy` 与 `transport` 交给 `createRpcHost({ plugins: [...] })`，并在 worker 入口安装对应子端来源。
解析顺序唯一：单次调用完整实例或 `false`，然后传输 plugin 的 feature，最后链路策略 plugin。把 `callOptions` 传给 `host.thread.request(method, payload, callOptions)` 即可覆盖本次调用。不能写 `{ timeout: 100 }`、`timeoutMs` 或 `defaultTimeoutMs`。
`false` 禁用所选策略，不移除已经继承的截止时间。下游只得到剩余预算，转发不能延期。只有发起方重试；超时或失联不证明业务未执行，非幂等操作须先对账。传输提供的握手准备期限是另一项配置，不是业务 timeout feature。
`notify` 的 Promise 只表示物理发送，不表示业务确认。`dispatch(target, method, payload, options)` 同步返回 `void`，失败交给原 reporter。每个目标按顺序执行自己的 group，没有跨目标事务。

安装 `idempotency()` 信息流 plugin 后，才有 `host.<ns>.outcome(key)` 查询保留的结果。省略 plugin 时不会启用按幂等键保存和查询结果的存储。`auth()` 独立拥有请求 ID 去重：实际业务及流清理完成前保留活动身份，完成后的身份按其有界 TTL 策略保留；重复身份不再次执行或发送终态。`auth.maxReplayEntriesPerPeer` 默认 `1024`，必须为正安全整数；容量不足以 `OVERLOADED` 拒绝，`auth.onRejected` 接收冻结的 `replayLedgerFull` 或 `groupReplayFull` 通知。该回调失败按原 `INTERNAL` 错误及原因上报。推荐安装 `limits()`；不安装就不启用相应并发、速率或 payload 配额。
`host.process.send('b', 'c.render', value)` 先到 b；b 查询当前目录，再通过自己持有的 c 会话转发，可跨载体。也可显式发布已持有能力：
持有的函数不自动跟随替换。目标断开时拒绝；未知方法、环路与超出跳数在原准入边界拒绝。转发不创建第二个调用端点或 per-session Peer 外观。
观察通过同一 host 的 `probe` 信息流 plugin 安装；类型生成消费已接受目录。事件视图只在 `emit` 期间有效，延后读取前须复制需要的字段。
把这两个定义与传输一起放入 `plugins`。`typegen.out.write` 是应用拥有的输出能力，文件 I/O 由应用决定；失败通过 reporter 传播。关闭 host 或卸载相应 plugin 后释放订阅。

blocks.text: 汇总入口和各单项默认子路径均可 tree-shake。错误码从 `@migaia/rpc-contract/error-code` 引入；错误类和契约从 `/errors` 引入。传输作者只提交原生载体与编解码能力，host 负责握手、Session、待决表与 provider 执行。
`host.close()` 与 `host[Symbol.asyncDispose]()` 共享原关闭 Promise；`host.<ns>.close()` 只关闭对应命名空间。拥有的原生资源由其原 owner 释放，借用资源仍按原生所有权处理。
按 `source/code` 识别错误，保留原生类型、stack、cause 与 errors。不要把超时、取消或未知结果当成业务未执行证明。原生成员控制位于传输贡献的 `host.<ns>.members`，池控制位于其 feature 贡献的 `host.<ns>.pool`；这些控制不替代调用入口。

`contract` defines protocol, interfaces, portable values, and errors. `host` owns RPC calls, sessions, handshake, providers, forwarding, and cancellation. Transport plugins own native connections, generations, codecs, framing, and transfer. Flow plugins and plugin-owned features implement their optional behavior.
A host can install multiple transports with calls isolated under `host.<ns>`. Mixing transport kinds in one host is not recommended; normally choose one kind per host.
中文 · Usage guide

This creates two real hosts in one event loop. The parent installs its timeout feature on the coroutine plugin. The child receives the generation-local connect handle. It prints `42` and releases native resources in finally.
Coroutines do not provide Worker isolation. Choose the process, thread, or browser transport for those native environments.

blocks.text: Untargeted calls select only within their namespace: zero targets return empty `fulfilled/rejected` maps, one returns a scalar, and multiple return maps indexed by instance identity. Stream iterators cancel independently. Root call methods such as `host.request` are removed.

`host.<ns>.send('b', 'c.render', value)` first reaches direct peer b, which reads its current directory and forwards to c. A held `host.<ns>.peers.c.render` does not retarget a later generation. Forwarding can cross namespaces and cannot extend an upstream deadline.
Install flow plugins in the host's `plugins`; install features in their owning plugin's `features`.

Aggregate and default subpath imports support tree-shaking. Other flow plugins are `auth`, `chunk`, `batch`, `idempotency`, `schema`, and `typegen`. Installing `limits` is recommended; omitting it enables no such quotas. `host.<ns>.outcome(key)` exists only with `idempotency` installed. `auth` independently owns request-ID replay retention; `maxReplayEntriesPerPeer` bounds retained identities per admitted peer, and `onRejected` receives replay-capacity refusal reasons.

Pool is the transport's `pool({ size })` feature. Members use one carrier kind and expose one logical peer. Pool owns member acquisition, scheduling, and closure; the transport contributes native `host.<ns>.members` controls.

`FeatureScope` alone selects call `options.timeout/retry`, then the transport's installed feature, then the link-policy default. Call values accept only complete feature instances or `false`, never numbers or configuration objects. `false` disables that policy but cannot remove an inherited chain deadline. Only the origin retries; forwarding does not restart the budget.

Every call kind supports `signal`, including cancellation propagated after a one-way physical send. Providers receive their own `context.signal`. Cancellation neither kills a process nor rolls back side effects.

Branch on `source/code`; preserve native classes, `stack`, `cause`, and `AggregateError.errors`. Timeout or disconnection does not prove that business work never executed. Reconcile uncertain non-idempotent work before retrying.

Plugin authors start at `@migaia/rpc-host/sdk`; observation lives under `/plugins/probe`. Old `/plugin`, `/probe`, endpoint, per-session Peer, and v1/JSON-RPC profile entries are removed. RPC module can depend directly on `@migaia/rpc-contract`. Import only `/error-code` when only codes are needed, without retaining protocol or codec execution code.
README · 中文

Contract defines protocol, interfaces, portable values, and errors. Host owns RPC sessions, handshake, calls, providers, forwarding, cancellation, and deadline propagation. Transport plugins own native connections, generations, and codecs. Flow plugins and plugin-owned features implement optional capabilities.

A host supports multiple transport namespaces, but normally choose one transport kind; mixing kinds is not recommended. Calls live under `host.<ns>.*`; provider registration and whole-host closure remain on the root. See the README for a complete runnable coroutine connection.

`provide` accepts nested function objects. Return values become business results and exceptions retain their error chain. Duplicate method names reject. Later registrations publish through the existing session directory update.

Callers cancel with `options.signal`; providers receive their own `context.signal`. The example deliberately waits for cancellation. Real tasks release their own resources in finally. Cancellation neither rolls back side effects nor automatically terminates a process. A one-way call can still propagate cancellation after physical sending completes.
A declaration can describe one capability or map direct names to several capabilities. The namespace selects a transport; names and instance IDs select targets within it.

Untargeted `request/notify/group` broadcasts within that namespace: zero targets return empty `fulfilled/rejected` maps, one returns a scalar, and multiple retain independent successes and failures. Multi-target `stream` returns iterators indexed by instance identity, each with independent backpressure and cancellation.

A stream starts at the first `next()`. `return()` ends consumption and waits for corresponding cleanup. `throw(reason)` preserves the caller's thrown reason. Held capabilities remain bound to their original connection after it retires; they cannot target a same-name successor.
This example creates cold definitions only. Pass `policy` and `transport` to `createRpcHost({ plugins: [...] })`, and install the corresponding child source in the worker entry.

Selection has one order: complete per-call instance or `false`, then the transport plugin's feature, then the link-policy default. Pass `callOptions` to `host.thread.request(method, payload, callOptions)` to override one call. Numeric `{ timeout: 100 }`, `timeoutMs`, and `defaultTimeoutMs` are removed.

`false` disables that policy without removing an inherited deadline. Downstream hops receive only the remaining budget and cannot extend it. Only the origin retries. Timeout or disconnection does not prove that business work never executed; reconcile uncertain non-idempotent work first. Transport handshake preparation deadlines are separate from the business timeout feature.

A `notify` Promise means physical sending completed, without business acknowledgement. `dispatch(target, method, payload, options)` returns `void` synchronously and reports failures. Each target executes its own ordered group; there is no cross-target transaction.

Install the `idempotency()` flow plugin to add `host.<ns>.outcome(key)` for retained results. Omitting it enables no store for retaining and querying results by idempotency key. `auth()` separately owns request-ID deduplication: active identities remain held through actual business and stream cleanup, then completed identities follow its bounded TTL policy. A duplicate executes no provider and sends no additional terminal. `auth.maxReplayEntriesPerPeer` defaults to `1024` and must be a positive safe integer; full capacity refuses with `OVERLOADED`, while `auth.onRejected` receives a frozen `replayLedgerFull` or `groupReplayFull` notice. Callback failure is reported with the existing `INTERNAL` error and original cause. Installing `limits()` is recommended; omitting it enables no corresponding concurrency, rate, or payload quotas.

`host.process.send('b', 'c.render', value)` reaches b first. b reads its current directory and forwards through its own c session, including across carriers. A host can also publish an explicit held capability:

Held functions do not follow replacements. Retired targets reject; missing methods, loops, and excessive hops reject at their admission boundaries. Forwarding creates no second endpoint or per-session Peer facade.
Install the `probe` flow plugin on the same host. Type generation consumes accepted directories. Event views are valid only during `emit`; copy required fields before retaining them.

Include both definitions alongside the transport in `plugins`. The application owns `typegen.out.write`, including any file I/O; failures reach the reporter. Host closure or plugin removal releases the corresponding subscriptions.

rows: One Host call owner and one new protocol, without compatibility entries

blocks.text: Aggregate and individual default subpaths support tree-shaking. Import codes from `@migaia/rpc-contract/error-code` and error classes/contracts from `/errors`. Transport authors supply native carriers and codecs; Host owns handshake, Sessions, pending calls, and provider execution.

`host.close()` and `host[Symbol.asyncDispose]()` share the original close Promise. `host.<ns>.close()` closes only that namespace. Original owners release owned native resources, while borrowed resources retain their native ownership policy.

Branch on `source/code`; preserve native classes, stack, cause, and errors. Timeout, cancellation, or an unknown result is not proof that work never executed. Native controls live under transport-owned `host.<ns>.members`; Pool controls live under feature-owned `host.<ns>.pool`. These controls do not replace RPC calls.

symbols.core:
timeout: Complete timeout feature or false for this invocation; an inherited chain deadline still bounds the attempt.
Inherit the transport feature, then link policy.
retry: Complete originating retry feature or false; transit forwarding never executes this strategy.
signal: Caller signal observed before admission and throughout completion. Cancelling a provider does not roll back side effects or kill a native process.
No caller signal.
transfer: Original ArrayBuffer list for native media supporting transfer. Unsupported media reject synchronously without reading a caller transfer getter.

trace: Application diagnostic correlation text propagated within protocol bounds, without granting authority.

No explicit logical key.
orderKey: Application ordering key; the shared provider FIFO starts same-key work in acceptance order and releases its receipt on every terminal path.
No ordering-key lane.
cancel: Explicit before-start cancellation policy for queued provider work; it does not roll back work that already entered the provider.
Canonical call cancellation behavior.
Cancel while provider work is still queued before entry.

blocks.text: `FeatureScope` 唯一解析覆盖顺序：单次调用 `options.timeout/retry`、所在传输 plugin 的 feature、链路策略 plugin。单次值只接受完整 feature 实例或 `false`，不接受数字或配置对象。`false` 禁用该策略，不能取消已经继承的链路截止时间。只有发起方重试；转发跳不重新开始预算。
所有调用种类支持 `signal`，单向调用物理发送之后也能向下游传播取消。provider 读取自己的 `context.signal`。取消不等于杀进程，也不回滚业务副作用。
按 `source/code` 识别错误，保留原生类型、`stack`、`cause` 和 `AggregateError.errors`。超时或断开不证明业务未执行；非幂等操作须先对账再考虑重试。

自定义 plugin 作者从 `@migaia/rpc-host/sdk` 开始。观察入口是 `/plugins/probe`；旧 `/plugin`、`/probe`、endpoint、per-session Peer 和 v1/JSON-RPC profile 已删除。rpc 家族可以直接依赖 `@migaia/rpc-contract`；只需错误码时导入 `/error-code`，不会带入协议与编解码执行代码。

symbols.signature: export declare function createRpcIdempotencyStore(options?: IRpcIdempotencyStoreOptions): IRpcIdempotencyStore;
symbols.purpose: Creates a bounded in-memory execution/outcome store with post-settlement retention. Byte pressure evicts completed bodies while retaining execution tombstones, so missing bodies do not authorize re-execution.
symbols.core:
IRpcIdempotencyStore with no timers or dispose obligation; the session/provider owner controls scope/key admission.
retentionMs: Positive safe-integer milliseconds retained after settlement; pending execution does not expire by this policy.
Default 300000; invalid nonpositive or unsafe integers fail INVALID_CONFIG.
maxEntries: Positive safe-integer total original entry capacity.
Default 1024; invalid nonpositive or unsafe integers fail INVALID_CONFIG.
maxEntriesPerScope: Positive safe-integer original entry capacity in each actual scope.
Default 256; invalid nonpositive or unsafe integers fail INVALID_CONFIG.
maxBytes: Positive safe-integer total retained portable-outcome byte budget.
Default 8388608; invalid nonpositive or unsafe integers fail INVALID_CONFIG.
maxOutcomeBytes: Positive safe-integer per-outcome retention budget; larger results leave an unavailable tombstone.
Default 1048576; invalid nonpositive or unsafe integers fail INVALID_CONFIG.
parameters: options: IRpcIdempotencyStoreOptions (optional)

seq: Emitter-local sequence assigned by the real emitter.

variation: Retained diagnostic slot; the single protocol has no variation dispatch API.

targetId: Original logical target address selected by the caller; forwarding retains this destination.
receiverId: Selected immediate receiving instance address; intermediaries cannot infer it from a payload.
peerId: Accepted direct instance address from the real Session view, distinct from its display name.
trace: Explicit caller correlation containing 1–256 printable ASCII characters; only this operation and its transparent forwarding inherit it.

sizeBytes: Observed size, or -1 when this actual layer cannot determine it.
chunkIndex: Chunk index only when known; -1 otherwise.
chunkCount: Actual chunk count only when known; -1 otherwise.
members: Actual batch member count, or -1 for a non-batch event.
durationMs: Actual owner duration at settlement, or -1 before settlement.
rejection: Actual provider refusal reason, never inferred from a shared error code.
lifecycle: Actual handshake, ready or closing transition when applicable.
error: Original local diagnostic reference; retaining a snapshot does not clone it.
carrier: Actual native observer label for this stage, when present.
detail: Borrowed stage-specific scalar details; follow the actual producer lifetime.
content: Present only when selected capture/redaction admits it; mask zero performs no sampling or copy.

blocks.text: `FeatureScope` 唯一解析覆盖顺序：单次调用 `options.timeout/retry`、所在传输 plugin 的 feature、链路策略 plugin。单次值只接受完整 feature 实例或 `false`，不接受数字或配置对象。`false` 禁用该策略，不能取消已经继承的链路截止时间。只有发起方重试；转发跳不重新开始预算。
所有调用种类支持 `signal`，单向调用物理发送之后也能向下游传播取消。provider 读取自己的 `context.signal`。取消不等于杀进程，也不回滚业务副作用。
按 `source/code` 识别错误，保留原生类型、`stack`、`cause` 和 `AggregateError.errors`。超时或断开不证明业务未执行；非幂等操作须先对账再考虑重试。

自定义 plugin 作者从 `@migaia/rpc-host/sdk` 开始。观察入口是 `/plugins/probe`；旧 `/plugin`、`/probe`、endpoint、per-session Peer 和 v1/JSON-RPC profile 已删除。rpc 家族可以直接依赖 `@migaia/rpc-contract`；只需错误码时导入 `/error-code`，不会带入协议与编解码执行代码。

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
name: Stable native registration name; accepted private members retain their first accepted name across departure/restart.
instanceId: Original accepted remote instance identity, not a fabricated native fingerprint.
generation: Original accepted generation tuple or explicitly declared native execution ordinal.
timestamp: Original monotonic event observation time, explicitly unavailable if not observed.
clock: Clock-domain label belonging to the original monotonic observation, not wall-clock epoch time.
reason: Canonical safe reason from the actual owner; no native handles, credentials or arbitrary error message.
code: Original native exit code or tagged diagnostic code according to the declaring field.
signal: Original native exit signal, explicitly unavailable when not observed.
error: Safe source/code projection only; no message/stack/cause or authority is exposed.
count: Original native restart count for this event.
degraded: Original native supervisor degradation reasons.
type: Original ready/exit/degraded/restart/terminal/liquidated event selected by the native owner.
